changelog: Phase L103.6 — billing flow per-location (additive, backward-compatible). YookassaRecurring::createInitialPayment + chargeStored accept optional location_id + tariff_code → wired into YK metadata. SubscriptionStore: 3 new public methods (updateLocationSubscription, getLocationSubscription, logEventForLocation) that touch the new control-plane subscriptions table. SubscriptionStore::onWebhook now reads metadata.location_id — if present, mirrors the active state into subscriptions row (succeeded → active+period_end, retryCount≥4 → suspended, retryCount≥2 → past_due) IN ADDITION to legacy updateTenantStatus call. Legacy webhooks without location_id flow through unchanged — zero regression. billing-cycle-worker rewrite + ['trial','enterprise'] skip-list cleanup DEFERRED to Phase L103.7/8 to keep this commit a hot-deploy-safe additive change.
